facility.name: Top of the World Preschool
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2705 VIRGINIA PKWY, MCKINNEY, TX, 75071

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Unsecured stage risers in the operation gym collapsed onto a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed utilizing a walker with wheels that would allow movement. Walkers are prohibited equipment and would allow infants to move around and have access to materials or may cause a hand injury to other infants during floor time. The deficiency was corrected during the inspection when the staff removed the infant out of the equipment and removed the prohibited equipment out of the classroom with CCR brought it to their attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: Three infants were missing current feeding schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose-fill surfacing for the swings and Preschool playground had a depth of 1-4 inches under and around the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: The loose-fill surfacing on the School Age playground had a depth of 1-4 inches under and around the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report: The operation did not have proof of a current gas leak inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(13))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: During a DFPS investigation, one caregiver was found to be missing pediatric first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: During a DFPS investigation, one caregiver was found to be missing pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: During an inspection, it was observed that a caregiver was not adhering to the conditions on their background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During an inspection, a caregiver was present with children prior to the operation receiving an eligibility letter from the Centralized Background Check Unit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection, there were 12 children aged two years old in a class with one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. Based on review of video, and interviews of children and staff, it was determined a caregiver left a child unsupervised in a classroom. The child left the building where their classroom was located. The child was found by another caregiver on the concrete path between the two buildings of the operation. The child was unsupervised for 6 minutes and 59 seconds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Floor Plan: Three of the eight rooms did not have emergency evacuation and relocation diagrams posted in the room. This was corrected at inspection when the operation printed out new diagrams and posted them in the rooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Floor Plan (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two of the four infants in care did not have current infant feeding schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation has not conducted a lockdown drill in the past year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. Through interviews with staff and children, and review of photos, it was determined that a caregiver had allowed children to sit on a fence to take photos on 3/4/2024. When a child was trying to sit on the same fence on 3/5/2024, the child fell off the fence and received two fractures in their wrist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three infants were missing current feeding schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: The operation was missing a copy of their current liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One of the ten personnel records reviewed was missing current training in handling hazardous materials and responding to food allergy emergencies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: One of the nine classrooms was missing an emergency evacuation map. This was corrected at inspection when the operation posted a new evacuation map in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The use zones of five pieces of stationary equipment overlapped use zones of nearby stationary equipment. This was corrected at inspection when the operation put caution tape around  the equipment to prevent children from using the equipment until the installer can come back out to the operation to properly install the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Five children who were identified by their parents as having food allergies did not have food allergy emergency plans on file
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The phone app that the operation uses to track children when transporting children did not have medical transport and treatment authorization forms that could be pulled up on the app. This was corrected at inspection when the operation made paper copies of the medical authorizations to carry on the school vans.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One of the ten personnel records reviewed was missing current training in pediatric first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The school van, manufactured in 2014, had a child safety alarm at the back on the vehicle but it was not operating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One of the ten personnel records reviewed was missing current training in pediatric cpr.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The standard was evaluated as part of a standard investigation and was not found compliant.    Based on the interviews with parents, staff, and a video, it has been determined that the caregiver did not use good judgement to redirect a child which resulted in the child sustaining an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
